note: Redwood park on the South Fork Eel River 1.5 mi north of Leggett, with two drive-in campgrounds, Rock Creek and Hickey, on the bluffs above the river; the river-flat Redwood Campground takes no trailers or vehicles over 18 ft. Much of the park, trails included, is cut off by high water in winter when the seasonal bridges come out, but at least one campground stays open. Swimming holes and fishing on the river. --Claude
